methodology: Pipeline simulation: verifier.py loaded directly with mock copy_from_env injecting synthetic result JSONs. Two do-nothing scenarios tested per Lesson 24.

do_nothing_no_export.description: copy_from_env raises FileNotFoundError (agent did nothing, export never ran)

do_nothing_baseline.description: Export ran but all fields at initial state (gwc_found=false, no gridsets, seed_triggered=false)

partial_no_seeding.description: GWC tile layer configured with EPSG:4326 + EPSG:900913 gridsets and image/png format, but tile seeding job never triggered. Score capped at 55 (below 60 threshold) per score cap gate.

full_success.description: All criteria met: GWC tile layer for ne:ne_countries + both gridsets + image/png + seeding triggered with done status

score_cap_gate: If seeding not triggered and score >= 60, score capped to 55 (Lesson 25 pattern: seeding is the required deliverable)
notes: GWC REST API is at /geoserver/gwc/rest/ (NOT /geoserver/rest/). Seed detection uses both GWC seed REST API response AND Tomcat access log for POST to /gwc/ paths. Metatile 4x4 and zoom 0-3 are expected but not strictly scored.
verification_method: export_result.sh -> /tmp/gwc_tile_cache_seeding_result.json -> copy_from_env -> JSON field parsing from GWC REST API responses + access log scan
